hebrewText: וַ/יִּמָּלֵ֣ט בֵּן אֶחָ֗ד לַ/אֲחִימֶ֨לֶךְ֙ בֶּן אֲחִט֔וּב וּ/שְׁמ֖/וֹ אֶבְיָתָ֑ר וַ/יִּבְרַ֖ח אַחֲרֵ֥י דָוִֽד

tokens.bdb: properly, to be smooth, i.e. (by implication) to escape (as if by slipperiness); causatively, to release or rescue; specifically, to bring forth young, emit sparks
tokens.kjv: deliver (self), escape, lay, leap out, let alone, let go, preserve, save, [idiom] speedily, [idiom] surely.

tokens.bdb: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
